title: An Algorithmic Framework for Bias Bounties
authors: Ira Globus-Harris, Michael Kearns, and Aaron Roth
source_version: arXiv:2201.10408v4 (governing mathematical source); ACM FAccT 2022, DOI 10.1145/3531146.3533172
human_summary: The development formalizes the paper's complete named theoretical surface: arbitrary-population definitions, certificate characterization, list-update progress and termination, adaptive checking, falsify-and-update procedures, VC-based training, ternary cost-sensitive reductions, and repaired coordinate ascent. It preserves executable finite-population counterparts, proves stronger arbitrary-label almost-everywhere semantics for Observation 4, and includes machine-checked counterexamples and corrected endpoints where the source needs repair.

human_summary_review.note: Set to human_approved only after explicit human approval; do not rewrite a human_approved summary without authorization.

human_review.source: v11 PaperInterface claim surface; human entries are recorded after direct review

paper_interface.maintainability_issue: The canonical review surface has eighteen source-facing semantic specifications: fourteen named results, three algorithms, and the certificate-optimization objective. Finite and arbitrary-law theorem variants are auxiliary proof support; definitions and other algorithms use direct semantic-declaration routes in the source map.

llm_statement_review.policy: For every selected source claim, compare only its exact byte-pinned raw source-anchor bundle and Lean's expanded transparent `...Spec : Prop` target. The paired proof endpoint receives separate Lean-Meta proof credit; a name, paraphrase, wrapper, or prior aggregate receipt is not a semantic match. Review every retained paper-local prerequisite and every material library prerequisite before the dependent claim.

llm_paper_coverage_review.policy: Inventory every claim-bearing named definition, observation, remark, theorem, lemma, optimization objective, and algorithm in the governing arXiv source, including repeated appendix presentations. Each main presentation must route to a canonical Spec or an exact direct semantic declaration; appendix repetitions must be presentation aliases. Quarantined source defects require exact-hash support judgments over the formal counterexample or repaired endpoint.

llm_assumption_review.policy: Every paper-facing theorem premise not derived from prior Lean declarations must be declared in Assumptions.lean, listed in assumption_names, and independently judged to be a genuine source/model assumption rather than proof debt.

llm_source_record_review.policy: Recursively inspect any visible record, certificate, replay, process, bridge, oracle, or broad package premise. Classify each boundary-shaped input and field by exact source evidence, Lean derivation, approved external boundary, or unresolved proof debt.

semantic_model_review.policy: For every reviewed row, compare the expanded feature, label, model, group, loss, sample-law, transcript, and oracle domains with the pinned source. Expose measurability and integrability premises, almost-everywhere versus pointwise conditional semantics, zero-mass-group totalization, iid sampling, adaptive state evolution, integer rounding, and finite versus arbitrary-population scope whenever present.

source_proof_fidelity_review.policy: Use schema 2. Minor source typos and corrected proof routes with unchanged substantive endpoints are formalized_note. Reserve formalized_with_caveat for a substantial source error with a fully proved corrected endpoint; weaker targets or added non-source assumptions are partially_formalized.
